nodes.name: Email the Studio
nodes.notes: Bound to the SMTP credential by id, so an import comes up ready to activate. The id is specific to one n8n instance: on any other instance, re-select the credential in this node. Gmail needs a 16-character App Password rather than the account password, and the From address must be that same account.
